## Events

### `custom`

Namespace of app-defined events. The core emits `custom.<name>` with the app's own attributes. App attribute keys may not use `lk.*`, `otel.*` or `session.id`.

### `lk.device.app_state.changed`

App moved to the foreground or background (and its initial value).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.app_state` | required |

### `lk.device.audio.interruption`

Audio session interruption began or ended.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.audio.interruption` | required |

### `lk.device.audio_route.changed`

Audio route changed.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.audio_route.outputs` | required |
| `lk.device.audio_route.reason` | required |

### `lk.device.battery.changed`

Charging changed, or the level crossed 20 % or 10 % unplugged. Never per percent.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.battery.charging` | required |
| `lk.device.battery.level` | required |

### `lk.device.capture.failed`

A capture device failed. Severity WARN.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.capture.device` | required |
| `lk.device.capture.reason` | required |

### `lk.device.low_power.changed`

Low Power Mode changed (and its initial value).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.low_power.enabled` | required |

### `lk.device.memory.changed`

Memory pressure changed (and its initial value).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.memory.pressure` | required |

Network path changed (and its initial value).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.network.constrained` | required |
| `lk.device.network.expensive` | required |
| `network.connection.type` | required |

### `lk.device.thermal.changed`

Thermal state changed (and its initial value).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.thermal.state` | required |

### `lk.ping`

Pipeline smoke test. Never emitted in production paths.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.ping.seq` | recommended |

### `lk.room.disconnected`

The Room left connected for good (never on a reconnect). INFO when the client hung up, WARN otherwise.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.disconnect.reason` | required |

## Spans

### `lk.connect` (client)

One connect attempt. Checkpoints, in order: ws_open, signal, join_recv, pc_created (required on every platform), then engine, pc_connected, offer_sent, answer_sent, room_connected (best effort).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: When `lk.outcome` is `error`. |
| `lk.connect.attempt` | required |
| `lk.outcome` | required |

### `lk.publish` (internal)

One track publish.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: When `lk.outcome` is `error`. |
| `lk.outcome` | required |
| `lk.track.kind` | required |
| `lk.track.source` | required |
| `lk.track_sid` | conditionally_required: On success. |

### `lk.reconnect` (client)

One reconnect cycle. Checkpoints are named `attempt <n> <mode>`, one per attempt (dynamic; open decision).

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: When `lk.outcome` is `error`. |
| `lk.outcome` | required |
| `lk.reconnect.attempts` | conditionally_required: After the first attempt. |
| `lk.reconnect.mode` | conditionally_required: After the first attempt. |
| `lk.reconnect.reason` | required |

### `lk.subscribe` (internal)

One subscription, from the intent to subscribe to the first media (or timed_out after 30 s). Checkpoints: subscribed, first_media.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: When `lk.outcome` is `error`. |
| `lk.outcome` | required |
| `lk.pii.remote_participant_identity` | recommended |
| `lk.track.kind` | required |
| `lk.track.source` | required |
| `lk.track_sid` | required |
